title: Feedback with bounded temporal scope
purpose: Represent feedback whose intended scope is a bounded interval rather than all history.

expected.semantic_interpretation: User feedback carries a bounded phenomenon interval as its temporal scope.
expected.observability: The feedback itself is explicit evidence.
expected.opportunity: No opportunity claim is required for this fixture.
expected.time: The phenomenon interval represents the period the feedback concerns.
expected.provenance: User source and event time preserve feedback provenance.
expected.raw_derived: Evidence kind is explicit and does not imply a pattern.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not infer a routine, preference, habit, or pattern conclusion.
